text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer?
Is there something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you feeling lonely, craving company,
or wanting a lap pillow or something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, lately...
no one has been letting me pamper them...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I really want to pet her and give her a big hug
and tell her what a good girl she is, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I feel lonely.
Trainer... will you pamper me...?
Unable to pamper anyone like she usually does, Super Creek seemed to have fallen out of form...
